title.full: How the Matched MediSave Scheme works

summary.text: You are assessed automatically each year. If you are eligible, make cash top-ups to your MediSave Account to get a matching grant.

details.heading: Scheme start date
details.body: MMSS is implemented from January 2026. Cash top-ups made before 2026 is not eligible for matching grants under this scheme.

details.heading: Tax relief rules
details.body: Individual givers will not receive tax relief for cash top-ups that attract the MMSS matching grant.

steps.name: Check eligibility
steps.text: Wait for the notification at the beginning of the year, or check your eligibility via the Healthcare dashboard.

steps.name: Make top-ups
steps.text: Make cash top-ups to your MediSave Account by 31 December of the year. Top-ups can be made by yourself, loved ones, employers or members of the community.

steps.name: Receive grant
steps.text: If you are eligible and have received cash top-ups to your MediSave Account by 31 December, you will receive a matching grant at the beginning of the following year.

sources.page_title: How does the Matched MediSave Scheme work?

quotes.text: Members’ eligibility for the Matched MediSave Scheme (MMSS) will be automatically assessed annually. No application by members is needed.
Each year, if you are eligible, we will notify you at the beginning of the year. You can also check your eligibility via the Healthcare dashboard.
Cash top-ups to MA can be made by yourself, loved ones, employers or members of the community.
If you are eligible and have received cash top-ups to your MediSave Account (MA) by 31 December of the year, you will receive a matching grant at the beginning of the following year.
MMSS is implemented from January 2026. Cash top-ups made before 2026 is not eligible for matching grants under this scheme.
Individual givers will not receive tax relief for cash top-ups that attract the MMSS matching grant.
